change_scope: Evidence-manifest repair and authority clarification only; no metric, prediction, training run, split, or conclusion changed.

secondary_or_protocol_metrics.boundary_proximity_detection: secondary analysis answering a different question from error detection
secondary_or_protocol_metrics.mc_T_convergence: protocol justification rather than a headline scientific result

conclusion_scope.supported: Uncertainty ranks prediction errors overall, while conditional error discrimination near true transitions is only modest; Temperature Scaling improves probability calibration without changing phase labels.
conclusion_scope.evidence_status: three-seed iterative-development evidence, not a fully independent confirmatory test
